newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh's Ershad says politics priority, not love.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh's Ershad says politics priority, not love.

text.p: Bangladesh's former military ruler Hossain Mohammad Ershad, his career threatened by a love affair, told followers on Wednesday that politics was his first love.
A leader of Ershad's Jatiya party quoted the 68-year-old former strongman as saying: "Politics is my priority and my first love, too."
"The chairman (Ershad) assured us that he would do nothing that harms the party and makes his political future uncertain," said the leader, who declined to be identified.
Lieutenant-General Ershad, who seized power in 1982, was deposed in 1990 and jailed.
He was freed in January, but stirred controversy when he celebrated his birthday recently with his lover of 14 years, member of parliament Zinat Hossain, instead of his wife.
Close associates in the Jatiya Party objected to such behaviour and three Jatiya leaders told newspapers on Wednesday they might break with Ershad and even split the party.
His wife of more than 40 years, Begum Roushan and also a legislator, briefly left Ershad to live with her sister.
Ershad, with help of several Jatiya leaders, persuaded Roushan to return home, but the rift has widened.
Some party colleagues and relatives are demanding an end to the ex-president's affair.
However, despite Ershad's assurances that he will not allow his personal life to interfere with politics, he is reported to be still deeply involved with Zinat.
"He will not listen to us, he is just crazy about that woman," one Jatiya leader said.
Ershad told the Sangbad newspaper: "My relationship with Zinat has been a 14-year affair. She has done a lot for me...I want to make a decision about her.
"My problem is now is one lady (Zinat), I feel very weak at this. And I don't know how to overcome it," Ershad said.
"I have made my proposal (of marriage) to Zinat and am awaiting her reply," he added.
Newspapers on Wednesday said Zinat, who is in her late forties, had told Ershad he must divorce Roushan before they can wed.
Jatiya sources said on Wednesday night they expected Ershad to "convince Zinat that a formal wedding could wait when romance continues to bloom".
One political source said he believed that political realities would eventually prevail over love.
"We believe Ershad is clever enough not to ruin his career," the source said.
